description: Token Risk Report checks a token contract the way careful buyers do, then explains it like a friend would. It measures the token's age, DEX liquidity depth, holder concentration and (on Solana) whether the mint and freeze authorities are still active, using only free public data (DexScreener, Solana RPC, Blockscout). Those measurements produce a deterministic 0-100 risk score, and Anna's AI turns them into a one-page report: the verdict, why, the red flags, and what would have to change. Built for the moment before you buy, when a wall of raw explorer data is not an answer.
name: Token Risk Report
tagline: Paste a token address, get a one-page risk report in plain language.
